cricket.zero_row_reason: No international or franchise fixture list for the capture window was returned by an official board feed during this session, so no cricket row is published. Publishing pairings without an official source would be inference.

darts.zero_row_reason: pdc.tv/tournaments, pdc.tv/live and pdc.tv/tournaments/european-championship each rendered only a cookie-consent wall and a cookie/vendor inventory to this fetcher at every chunk depth - no draw, no pairings, no times. The 2026 European Championship window (22-25 October, Westfalenhallen Dortmund) was confirmed official via pdc.tv/calendar, but no pairing was read, so no row is published.

esports.zero_row_reason: No esports fixture list for the capture window was returned by an official tournament organiser during this session, so no row is published.

gaelic-football.zero_row_reason: The inter-county GAA season had concluded inside the capture window and no official fixture list was returned, so no row is published.

golf.zero_row_reason: The DP World Tour schedule returned the Genesis Championship (event 40 of 42, Korea) as in-play at the moment of capture - the round indicator read 'Round 2 Tee Times Available'. In-play events are excluded by this layer's rules and no later event was listed as scheduled, so golf publishes zero rows.

greyhounds.zero_row_reason: No official greyhound racing fixture feed was reachable during this session, so no row is published.

rugby-league.zero_row_reason: No rugby-league fixture inside the capture window was returned by an official league source during this session, so no row is published.

tennis.zero_row_reason: atptour.com/en/scores/current returned only matches already live or completed at the moment of capture (Almaty tid 9410, Brussels tid 7485, Lyon tid 496) plus news widgets; atptour.com/en/scores/2026-10-23 and the /draw/results route both returned HTTP 404. No future-session pairing was read, so tennis publishes zero rows.

volleyball.zero_row_reason: No volleyball fixture inside the capture window was returned by an official federation source during this session, so no row is published.

excluded.what: NHL games dated 2026-10-22 (five read from api-web.nhle.com/v1/schedule/2026-10-22, game ids 2026020154-2026020158) and every W-L-OTL record carried beside the published 23-24 October fixtures
excluded.reason: The 22 October games were in-play at the moment of capture, so they are excluded from the published slate. The same feed showed that records beside the 23-24 October fixtures had not absorbed the 22 October results, so every published NHL record is a 2026-10-21 snapshot. Both facts are disclosed rather than normalised.

excluded.what: Nathan MacKinnon's assists total in the Colorado game-leader block (2026-10-23 feed)
excluded.reason: The value was truncated at the end of the fetched chunk and is stored as null. It is not published anywhere on this layer; the remaining five named leaders for that game were read completely.

nba.com/games?date=2026-10-22 rendered only per-day game counts (22 Oct = 2, 23 Oct = 12, 24 Oct = 8, 25 Oct = 7, 26 Oct = 9) and the fixture list itself failed to render. cdn.nba.com scoreboard, data.nba.net scoreboard, nba.com/game and stats.nba.com scoreboardv2 all returned errors. No pairing was read, so no NBA row is published; the nine EuroLeague rows are this layer's basketball coverage.

excluded.what: EuroLeague Round 7 fixture E2026/70 (Hapoel IBI Tel Aviv v Crvena Zvezda Meridianbet)
excluded.reason: Read from the official game centre but not published as a fixture: Hapoel IBI Tel Aviv had already played Round 7 on 2026-10-21 (90-81 v Virtus Bologna) and stands at 5-2 over 7 GP while every other club shows 6 GP. The game centre therefore lists a Round 7 row that is already complete, and publishing it would double-count the round.

excluded.what: EHF European Cup Men fixtures dated 2026-10-23 and 2026-10-24 (nine read from ehfcl.eurohandball.com) and the IHF Women's World Championship 2027 qualifiers Estonia v Kosovo / Kosovo v Estonia
excluded.reason: Captured first-hand but published without originated prices: the EHF pages exposed no group-standings table for the European Cup or for the World Championship qualifiers in this session, and originating a line with no strength input would be inference.

excluded.what: A 20:45 fixture on 2026-10-29 beginning with Montpellier Handball
excluded.reason: The listing was cut off at the end of the fetched chunk. The opponent was read separately on the official standings page (Montpellier Handball v Dinamo Bucuresti, match id 202711020101055) and is published, but the truncation is disclosed here so the two readings can be reconciled manually.

excluded.what: Two 2026 Northern Ireland Open Round 3 fixtures (David Gilbert v Ka Wai Cheung; Jak Jones v Daniel Wells) and two 09:00 fixtures on Thursday 22 October
excluded.reason: Neither player in those two fixtures appears in the 21 Round 1/Round 2 results read from wst.tv, so there is no first-hand strength input for them: they are published with blank lines and the reason rather than with an inferred price. Separately, the official page does not state a timezone, so the two 09:00 fixtures may already have begun when this page is published.

excluded.what: United Rugby Championship Round 4 kickoff times
excluded.reason: The official Round 4 listing renders times as 'Local' without naming a timezone, and one fixture renders '12:15' on Saturday 24 October an hour earlier than the rest of the round. Times are published verbatim as read and flagged rather than converted or normalised.
